method: Classified by reading crates/engine/src/cmd/ (mod.rs command_specs() aggregates each module's specs(); I followed every run fn into its module), plus the library crates its commands reach (plugins, color/cms, render/proof, text/fontdb). I grepped the engine for std::fs, the fileio read_file/write_file/create_dir/file_stamp helpers, std::env, cms::set_active/register_icc, proof::set_view, plugins::registry, every `s.prefs` write, and Session::execute/execute_step. vectorcraft's engine has NO network or device code: help.* only returns constant URLs and print.* writes PDF/PostScript bytes to a path or dataBase64, never to a printer, so only safe/file/code/host occur. Verified the naming traps named in the brief (clipboard.* is the in-memory engine clipboard, not the OS clipboard; file.* holds in-session ids; library/preset/profile loaders read files; plugin.* and effect.apply run code). Limits: a few ids reach more than one class and are taken at the strictest (color.loadProfile reads a path AND mutates the process-wide CMS -> host; file.new creates a doc but records a recent-size preference -> host); effect.apply/appearance.addEffect are code only insofar as a plug-in is already in the process-wide registry.

rules.why: Edit the open document only (transform/arrange/group/pathfinder/compoundPath/clippingMask/blend/envelope/mesh/pattern/repeat/slice/expand/rasterize/path ops); no path, preferences or process-wide state.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/object.rs, menucmds.rs, pathops.rs, live.rs, patterncmds.rs, slices.rs: all run through s.edit on the active document

rules.why: With nothing selected it writes the Blend Options into the preferences (s.prefs.blend_options), the new-blend defaults for the whole app, not the document.
Path/anchor geometry and the knife/cut tools on the open document (path.create draws a new path); session only.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/path.rs, draw2.rs, cut.rs, create.rs: s.edit on the active document

rules.why: Selection and saved selections in the session/document (select.same.*, select.object.*, select.magicWand, select.font select text by font); no I/O.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/select.rs, docmenu.rs, fonts.rs: mutate st.selection / s.menu saved selections

rules.why: Layer tree edits and the Layers-panel row highlight/locate (session state); no path or prefs.
Artboard create/delete/props/fit/move/reorder/duplicate; copy/cut use the in-memory clipboard. Document/session only.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/layer.rs, panelcmds.rs, menucmds.rs, xform.rs: s.edit on artboards

rules.why: Fill/stroke/gradient/freeform-gradient edits and paint proxies/recent colours in the document and session; paint.sampleColor applies a colour. No OS access.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/paint.rs, gradient.rs, freeform.rs, xform.rs: s.edit / session paint defaults

rules.why: Stroke settings, width points and applying a width profile edit the open document.
Read/write the saved width profiles in the preferences (s.prefs.width_profiles), app-wide state, not the document.
Appearance-panel fills/strokes/effects stack edits on the document; setActiveItem/showAllHidden/targetContents are session view of it.

An alias of effect.apply (runs effectcmd::apply). Safe ONLY because the door checks its effect against the engine's built-in effect catalog (and the `id` alias effectcmd::apply also reads), so an effect plug-in id "plugin.<id>" never runs through the door; a built-in effect only appends a live-effect record to the selection's appearance in the open document. Without that door check it is code (effect "plugin.<id>" starts an installed WebAssembly plug-in).
evidence: crates/effects/src/lib.rs:403-406 new_effect returns None for an uninstalled id; 513 apply_one runs an installed plug-in only

rules.why: Writes the New Art Has Basic Appearance preference (s.prefs.new_art_basic), app-wide, not the document.
Query (effect.list) and edits of effects already on the document's appearance (remove/setParams/expandAppearance/duplicate/move); expandAppearance bakes present effects to objects.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/effectcmd.rs: edit_effects via s.edit; list is a query

rules.why: Appends a live effect by id to the selection's appearance. Safe ONLY because the door checks its effect against the engine's built-in effect catalog (and the `id` alias effectcmd::apply also reads), so an effect plug-in id "plugin.<id>" never runs through the door; a built-in effect edits the open document's appearance only (no path, preferences, plug-in registry or network). Without that door check it is code (effect "plugin.<id>" starts an installed WebAssembly plug-in).
evidence: crates/effects/src/lib.rs:403-406 new_effect returns None for an uninstalled id; 513 apply_one runs an installed plug-in only

rules.why: Runs a caller-supplied list of OTHER commands ({commands:[{command,params}]}) via Session::execute_step as one undo step; only a nested batch is refused, so it executes file.*, prefs.set, plugin.* and every other id that a deny-list on the single id "command.batch" cannot inspect.
evidence: crates/engine/src/lib.rs:1022-1029 execute_step -> self.execute(id, params) over the full registry

rules.why: Default for the document namespace is the host's file surface: open/save/export/place read or write a path (or import bytes), which the service resolves. New document ids here go to file by default.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/fileio/load.rs:264-280 source()/open read_file(path); export.rs:46-62, mod.rs:808-847 write_file(path); pdfimport.rs:143 pdf_info reads source bytes

rules.why: In-session queries and document-only edits that touch no path: inspect/node/find/json/info/formats/exportSettings/pdfSettings read, serialize and exportForWeb.preview return bytes/dataBase64 in memory, activate/setUnits/setup/rasterEffectsSettings edit the session or document.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/edit.rs:27-31 inspect/node/find/json/setUnits; fileio/export.rs:16 serialize returns data; fileio/mod.rs formats; docinfo.rs info

rules.why: Default for the file namespace is host file access the service refuses: saveAs/saveCopy/saveAsTemplate/newFromTemplate/revert, place/place.info/place.queue, recovery.save/list/restore/discard, package, and print (which writes a PDF/PostScript file or dataBase64 - never a printer).
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/fileio/save.rs:473 save -> write_file; place/mod.rs:130 fileio::source read; recovery.rs:277-288 FolderStore read/write/remove; package.rs:117 write_file; print.rs:111-160 write_or_return(path)

rules.why: Session/document only: close removes an in-session document (its recovery copy is cleared only if a store is configured), formatOptions/info are queries, documentColorMode converts the open document's colour mode in memory.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/edit.rs:102 file_close -> s.close_document; docmenu.rs:614 close_all; fileio/save.rs:502 format_options; fileinfo.rs file_info; colormgmt.rs:262 convert_mode (no cms::set_active)

rules.why: file.new creates an in-session document but records the size in the Recent-sizes preference; newPresets reads and save/delete write the saved New Document presets in the preferences (app-wide, persisted), not the document.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/newdoc.rs:541-577 file_new -> remember() writes s.prefs.recent_new_docs; 596-625 save/delete write s.prefs.new_doc_presets

rules.why: Linked-image commands reach the images' files on disk: check/list/info stat them, update/relink/embed read them, unembed writes one to a path.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/links.rs:209-312 probe/read_image use read_file+file_stamp; unembed:524 write_file

rules.why: goTo selects an image object; placementOptions edits the placement setting on the document. Neither touches the file.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/links.rs:767 go_to selects; 904 placement_options via s.edit

rules.why: Swatch and colour-group edits (new/delete/edit/merge/group/spot/addUsedColors) and swatch.resetDefaults act on the open document's swatches.
Swatch libraries live in files: list rescans the user library folder, save writes a .vcswatches/.gpl/.css file (or into the user folder), load reads a path or another document.
get returns an already-loaded or built-in library; add copies named library swatches into the document. Neither rescans or reads disk on its own.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/swatchlib.rs:365 get via library() (no rescan); 399 add via s.edit

rules.why: Graphic-style edits (apply/new/delete/duplicate/redefine/breakLink/rename/merge/move/sortByName/library get/addFromLibrary) and queries act on the open document.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/style.rs, stylelib.rs:122 get / 154 add via s.edit

rules.why: libraries rescans the user library folder; saveLibrary writes a .vcstyles file (or into the user folder); loadLibrary reads a path or another document.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/stylelib.rs:110 list->rescan, 208 save->write, 218 load; Libraries::rescan/write/load in swatchlib.rs:131-210

rules.why: Writes the Override Character Color preference (s.prefs.override_char_color), app-wide, not the document.
Brush library and application are stored in the open document; object.expandBrush bakes brush art. No OS access.
Symbol definitions/instances live in the open document (new/place/edit/update/replace/spray/adjust).
Pattern options/list/delete/transform act on the document's patterns.
gradient.selectStop is session state (the selected gradient stop).
Opacity masks, blending modes and page knockout/isolation edit the document; new-mask flags are session state (s.menu).
Type edits on the document (changeCase, smartPunctuation, convertTo*, pathOptions, createOutlines, size, orientation, insert).
Text content/style/range/thread/tabs edits and the font queries (text.fonts/fontList/replaceFont) act on the document and the already-loaded font list.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/typecmd.rs, textedit.rs, threads.rs, tabs.rs, fonts.rs: s.edit / FontDb queries

rules.why: Scans the system font folders and reads font files to refresh the global FontDb (reads files outside any caller folder).
Character-style edits/queries on the open document's text styles.
Paragraph-style edits/queries on the open document's text styles.

The engine's INTERNAL clipboard held in session memory, not the OS clipboard (the UI owns that): export/import convert to/from SVG/PNG/PDF/text/EMF entirely in memory from svg/data/dataBase64, never a path or system paste.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/clipboard.rs:1-10 header + 194 import_svg(&svg, None) folder=None; clipboard/flavours.rs:274-345 import_* take dataBase64/text, fileio::load on in-memory bytes

rules.why: Undo/redo, the internal-clipboard cut/copy/paste*/pasteWithoutFormatting, clear, duplicate, find/replace and edit.colors.* recolouring all act on the session and open document.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/edit.rs:40-98 undo/copy/paste; typemenu.rs find_replace; colorcmds.rs recolor

rules.why: Change the process-wide colour-management state: colorSettings sets the active working spaces, assignProfile tags the document and makes the assigned profiles active (cms::set_active), app-wide, not the document alone.
color.harmony/convert/gamutCheck/plates compute colours; no path or persistent state.

Registers an ICC profile into the process-wide CMS registry (host state outside the document) AND reads an arbitrary .icc/.icm path from disk; taken at the strictest class, host - a file-scoped door must still deny it because it mutates app-wide colour state and reads an unscoped path.
evidence: crates/color/src/cms/mod.rs:286-288 std::fs::read + register_icc into static USER

rules.why: The colour-theme library lives in the preferences: list reads and save/delete write s.prefs.color_themes (app-wide, persisted).
Adds a saved theme's colours to the open document's Swatches panel as a colour group.
Canvas/document view toggles and saved views: drawMode, transparencyGrid, printTiling, slices.hide/lock, guides.make/release/lock/clear and saved.* are session or document state.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/views.rs, slices.rs:589-599, docmenu.rs guides, printtiling.rs:49 show

rules.why: Set the process-wide render proof view (proof::set_view), app-wide display state outside the document.
Ruler guides on the open document (add/list/select/remove/move).
Recolor Artwork reads and reassigns the selection's colours in the document.
Live Paint groups/fills/strokes edit the open document.
Shape Builder merge/regions edit the open document.
Image Trace make/expand/release operate on an image already in the document; no path.
Magic Wand settings are session state (s.menu.wand); options is a query.
Create primitive shapes in the open document.
Graph create/setData/setType build a graph object in the document from inline data.
image.info reports an image object already in the document.
node.move reorders a node within the document tree.
slice.list reports the document's slices.
attributes.set edits the document's object attributes (URL joins a session recent list); path.setFillRule edits the fill rule.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/attributes.rs:20-29 via s.edit; recent_urls is session

rules.why: Asset Export collection and shared export settings are kept in the document (add/remove/rename/list/settings.set).
Exports each asset to files via document.exportForScreens (writes a folder when given, else returns data).
css.selection and css.generate return CSS text for the document's objects (queries).
Writes the generated CSS (and rasterized picture PNGs) to a path when given, else returns the data.
Perspective grid definition, planes, attach/release/transform and the lock/station/snap/rulers view toggles are stored in the document's grid.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/perspgrid.rs, distortcmds.rs: store_grid via s.edit / silent()

rules.why: list reads and save/delete write the saved perspective presets in the preferences (app-wide).
Read/write a .vcperspective presets file at a path (else data).
Writes the Plane Switching Widget preference (s.prefs.perspective_widget), app-wide.
print.setup/preview and print.tiling/tiling.set compute and store print settings in the document; no file or printer.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/print.rs:75-108 setup/preview; printtiling.rs tiling/set_origin via s.edit

rules.why: list reads and save/delete write the saved print presets in the preferences (app-wide).
Read/write a .vcprintpresets file at a path (else data).
list reads and save/delete write the saved PDF presets in the preferences (app-wide).
Read/write a .vcpdfpresets file at a path (else data).
list reads and save/delete write the saved flattener presets in the preferences (app-wide).
Read/write a .vcflattener presets file at a path (else data).
Computes what flattening the document would do; returns a report, no I/O.
Save-for-Web settings and presets are kept in the preferences: settings and presets.list/save/delete read or write s.prefs.web_export_* (app-wide).
prefs.get/list/reset read or reset the application preferences (folders, clipboard handling, units...), app-wide state outside the document.

Setting the Additional Plug-ins Folder preference triggers sync_prefs, which loads every *.wasm in that folder into the process-wide plug-in registry (plug-in install that outlives the call), so prefs.set can run code the same way plugin.install does; it also persists app settings. The current vector.run gate MISSES this: the id is not plugin.*/file.* and the folder value rides under the key "value", which the path-key filter does not check.

The plug-in system: install/run/reload install or execute WebAssembly plug-ins into the process-wide registry (install from a path or in-band dataBase64; reload loads a folder), list/info/remove read or manage that shared registry. Already refused wholesale by the service.
Help-menu actions that return constant external URLs (Discord/website/app page/GitHub) for the UI to open; the engine performs no network or file I/O itself.
Writes the Eyedropper Options preference group (s.prefs.eyedropper), app-wide.
